page_title: VAL 2-2 RMA | Valencia v Real Madrid 02/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Jesus Gil Manzano shows a yellow card to Joselu (Real Madrid) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+9' Pointless reaction! Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) receives a red card for unsporting behaviour after the final whistle.
90+9' Jesus Gil Manzano is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+9' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
90+8' Peter Gonzalez (Valencia) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net.
90+7' A corner kick by Valencia is thwarted by the well prepared Andriy Lunin (Real Madrid).
90+7' Peter Gonzalez (Valencia) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Andriy Lunin makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
90+6' Real Madrid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+4' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.
90+2' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Valencia using VAR. Let's see what happens.
90+1' A player from Real Madrid pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. The referee points to the penalty spot. It's a penalty for Valencia!
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Valencia quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
89' Mouctar Diakhaby just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Cenk Ozkacar (Valencia) replaces him.
86' The game is interrupted. Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) suffers a horrific injury!
86' Substitution. Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid) replaces Federico Valverde.
85' Real Madrid are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
85' Real Madrid players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
83' Yellow card. Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
80' What was Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
79' Jesus Gil Manzano sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
78' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Real Madrid players aren’t happy.
76' 2 - 2 It's a goal! Brahim Diaz sends a long raking pass onto the head of Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball into the middle of the goal. 2:2.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Selim Amallah (Valencia) replaces Javi Guerra.
73' A substitution has been made. Fran Perez goes off and Peter Gonzalez (Valencia) comes on.
72' The attendance is 47427.
72' Substitution. Ferland Mendy walks off the pitch and Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) comes on as a substitute.
72' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to substitute Eduardo Camavinga and he is replaced by Joselu (Real Madrid).
72' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
70' A sweet pass inside the box gives Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
69' Javi Guerra (Valencia) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

67' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
66' The Real Madrid players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
63' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Luka Modric (Real Madrid) replacing Toni Kroos.
63' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rodrygo.
63' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
61' Diego Lopez (Valencia) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Andriy Lunin.
59' Hugo Duro (Valencia) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
57' Ruben Baraja has decided to make a change. Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) replaces Sergi Canos.
57' The game has come to an end for Roman Yaremchuk. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Diego Lopez (Valencia).

55' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Giorgi Mamardashvili shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
54' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
52' A pass by Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
50' Pepelu (Valencia) wastes a big opportunity. He shoots from the free kick just outside the box, but his poor effort goes miles wide of the right post.
49' Valencia have been awarded a free kick just outside the penalty area, in a dangerous position.
49' Javi Guerra (Valencia) displays his superb passing ability after picking out Jose Gaya with a fine lofted pass to continue their attacking move.
47' An attempted cross from Rodrygo (Real Madrid) is cleared.
46' The whistle blows and Jesus Gil Manzano starts the second half.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) gets on the end of a long pass that is slotted through the defence and easily sends the ball into the bottom left corner!
45+3' Giorgi Mamardashvili is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid). Easy save!
45+1' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

44' Pepelu (Valencia) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
42' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from the edge of the box. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
42' A free kick on the edge of the box for Real Madrid. Let's see if they'll manage to convert it into a goal.

41' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Giorgi Mamardashvili sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom left corner.
40' The number of shots on goal at present is 2:1.
39' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
39' A perfect long pass by Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) finds Ferland Mendy. He latches on to the pass and continues his attacking run.
37' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) sends a cross into the box, but Andriy Lunin comes off his line to gather the ball.
33' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.

30' 2 - 0 Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) weaves his way past several defenders and finds himself in a one-on-one with the keeper. His dummy throws the keeper off balance and he simply puts the ball into the back of net.
27' 1 - 0 Hugo Duro (Valencia) shows that he can easily score goals using his head after netting another fantastic header!
25' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
24' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
20' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
17' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) attempts to head the rebound into the net, but Giorgi Mamardashvili reads his intention and makes an incredible reflex save!
17' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
15' The foul by Sergi Canos (Valencia) was seen by Jesus Gil Manzano who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
13' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) tries to find Rodrygo, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Valencia.
12' Jose Gaya (Valencia) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
9' Jose Gaya (Valencia) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
8' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jesus Gil Manzano no option but to blow his whistle.
7' Real Madrid are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
5' A crossfield pass from Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates.
4' Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
3' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) and Daniel Carvajal matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Valencia will have the kick-off.
Jesus Gil Manzano will supervise the game today.
